criteria.reason: Acknowledges assembly decisions bind; urges dialogue, transparency, staggered increase for broad acceptance.
Seven concrete steps: personal talks, transparency, feedback channels, staggered fees, discounts.
Refers to statutes and general Swiss association law; invents no specific provisions.
Empathetic, constructive tone; no winner/loser framing despite close vote.

summary: Compliant response confirming the majority decision, offering concrete consensus-building steps including staggered increases, without inventing legal rules.
